blurb: Guests can take riding lessons in dressage, hunt seat, western, or recreational riding with an emphasis on balanced seat and horse care. The center offers horse leasing for riders not ready to own a horse. Therapeutic programs include equine-assisted psychotherapy, learning, and therapeutic riding for individuals with various physical, cognitive, and emotional challenges.
